items.subtitle: ctx.ontick.exec current-value parameter and full-expression updates
items.contents:
ctx.ontick.exec current-value parameter

ctx.ontick.exec() now passes the current value of its ScriptNode input as the callback's first argument. The value is passed through without inferring or converting its type. The first call receives the input's existing value; later calls receive the complete expression's previously applied result.

ctx.ontick.exec(value => value - 1)

The whole expression is now recalculated on each runtime tick, so arithmetic around ctx.ontick.exec() remains live too:

1 - ctx.ontick.exec(() => ctx.global.counter)

Zero-argument callbacks continue to work. The runtime context is available as the second callback argument. The callback parameter can also use this as an alias, for example ctx.ontick.exec(this => this - 1).

items.subtitle: Particle Sprite rendering and transparency
items.contents: Fixed Sprite particles so selected sprite assets resolve reliably and render using their original image proportions and alpha transparency. Sprite modulation is now clipped to the non-transparent pixels, and particle drawing resets canvas compositing locally to prevent rectangular artifacts from leaking into sprite rendering.

items.subtitle: Color variable data type
items.contents: Added the Color variable data type. Color values use hexadecimal color strings and are supported by setVariable.

items.subtitle: Physics Script Library expressions
items.contents: Added the Physics expression group with Body, Mass, Gravity, Friction, Bounciness, Fixed Rotation, and isCollider values. Set Physics now applies only changed values and avoids rebuilding physics caches on every tick.

items.subtitle: OnCollideWith exit output
items.contents: OnCollideWith now has a falsy output. It fires once when a collision ends, and can fire again only after the next collision begins and ends.

items.subtitle: Runtime Rerun
items.contents: Added Rerun between Output and Stop. It restarts the current scene by reusing the existing Play or Debug launch path.

items.subtitle: setSprite Strength
items.contents: Added Strength to setSprite. It controls sprite modulation strength from 0% to 100%.

items.subtitle: ScriptNode drag and canvas zoom
items.contents: Dragging a ScriptNode no longer bubbles into the canvas pan or pinch handlers. Canvas zoom is suppressed while a ScriptNode is being dragged.
